lines.text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Palm Crest Properties. My name is Hana. How can I help you today?
Hi Hana. I'm looking to buy a two-bedroom apartment as an investment, maybe in Jumeirah Village Circle.
Sure. Is this purely for rental income, or might you live in it later?
Purely rental. What kind of return can I expect?

I can't guarantee any return. Recent rental yields for two-bedrooms in that area have been around six to seven percent, but it depends on the building, service charges and the market, so please treat that as an estimate only.
Fair enough. My budget is around one point four million dirhams.
Thank you. Are you looking at ready units or off-plan, and when are you hoping to buy?
Ready, and within the next three months.
Understood. Will you need a mortgage, or is this a cash purchase?
Okay. I have a few ready two-bedroom units in that range. I'll send you some options and you can let me know which ones you like.
Sounds good. Please send them to my email, it's d dot ahmed at example dot com.
Got it, d dot ahmed at example dot com. I'll send them today. Thank you for calling.
